description: The video shows a split-screen layout with the lower half featuring a woman speaking directly to the camera. The upper half of the screen displays various video clips related to the topics she's discussing. At 9.0s, the upper half shows a courtroom scene with people in formal attire, some speaking from a podium. At 10.5s, the upper half changes to a scene of a crowd, possibly a protest or political gathering, with people in uniform and civilians, some holding microphones. At 12.0s, the upper half changes again to show four young men with cards pinned to their chests depicting cockroaches.
description_orig: Split screen with a court proceeding and the host.

Below this, there's a 'MANIFESTO' with five key points presented as icons and text: 'AAM AADMI PEHLE', 'BHRASHTACHAR MUKT BHARAT', 'SHIKSHA, SWASTHYA, SAMMAN', 'ROZGAR AUR AVSAR', and 'SWACHH, SUKRAKSHIT, SUSTAINABLE DELHI NCR'. Further down, a 'Voice of the Lazy & Unemployed' text is shown, along with a mock 'Approved Official Poster' for the party.
A man's face slowly transforms into a giant cockroach head, and his arms become insect-like claws. He then crosses his arms over his chest.

The bottom half features a woman talking. Overlaid text appears and changes sequentially: 'caste slur and', 'into a symbol', 'of collective', 'resistance.'.
